findings.title: `show` is documented and coded as read-only but requires a model credential
findings.test_evidence: ruby -Itest test/agent_cli_test.rb -> 34 runs / 764 assertions / 0F; show tests at :187 and :703 pass only because a model_factory is always injected; no test runs show without a factory (not found)
findings.recommendation: In run_durable, when read_only is true skip build_model/build_toolbox and reuse the inert model the file's own read-only helpers already use (build_list_session cli.rb:568-577, peek_session_record cli_authority.rb:194-197), and skip build_mcp_source.

findings.title: `resume --help` and `cancel --help` call exit() from inside CLI.run, violating the run-returns-a-status contract
findings.test_evidence: ruby -Itest test/agent_cli_test.rb -> 34 runs / 764 assertions / 0F; only global --help is tested (test/agent_cli_test.rb:34); no subcommand --help test exists (not found); documentation/reference/cli.md:47 promises subcommand --help works
findings.recommendation: Replace the two bare .parse! calls (cli.rb:744, cli_session_commands.rb:199) with the existing accept_json-style helper (or order! plus an explicit -h that throws) and add resume/cancel to NEEDS_HELP_CATCH so the throw is caught.

findings.title: --help on the comms/queue/schedule/observe command groups is a usage error (exit 64) despite NEEDS_HELP_CATCH listing them
findings.test_evidence: ruby -Itest test/comms_cli_test.rb -> 12 runs / 60 assertions / 0F; no group-level --help test (not found)
findings.recommendation: In each group dispatcher's else branch treat --help as a help request (print the group usage, return 0) instead of raising InvalidArgument; the verb-level help already works.

findings.title: Untrusted content (model answer, tool preview, tool/route names) reaches the operator terminal with no control-sequence escaping
findings.test_evidence: ruby -Itest test/agent_cli_test.rb -> 34 runs / 764 assertions / 0F; secret-redaction is tested but control-byte neutrality is not (not found)
findings.recommendation: Add one private helper on CLIRendering that strips C0/C1 control bytes using the same character class session_effects.rb:347 already uses, and route the answer and preview puts calls through it.

findings.title: `observe tail --follow` is unbounded in memory, re-reads the whole journal every 0.2s, and installs no signal trap
findings.test_evidence: ruby -Itest test/observability_cli_test.rb -> 2 runs / 11 assertions / 0F (observability library, not observe tail); no test of observe tail/--follow (not found)
findings.recommendation: Bound the dedup set (key on a monotonic offset, or drop identities outside a fixed window) and install the same Cancellation::Trap-based stop the worker and gateway loops use.

findings.title: EXIT_PAUSED (3) conflates 'operator gave no answer' with 'the thread is blocked'; the distinction exists only in --json
findings.test_evidence: ruby -Itest test/agent_cli_test.rb -> 34 runs / 764 assertions / 0F covers the paused/EXIT_PAUSED cases
findings.recommendation: None; verified design fact. The JSON cli.paused event already carries reason (cli.rb:246, :339) for callers that need the distinction.

findings.title: safety_counters headless_auto_approvals is a hardcoded 0 rather than a count of evidence, against the method's own stated principle
findings.test_evidence: not found: no test asserting the counter is derived
findings.recommendation: None required today; the value is correct by design (cmd_approve records a decision and does not execute). If it should be evidence-derived it belongs with the other three counters; otherwise its comment should name it an invariant assertion.

duplicates.detail: cli.rb:650-663 build_mcp_source passes only the RuntimeDirectory to McpSourceBuilder.new(directory).build (cli.rb:662); McpSourceBuilder derives its server list solely from directory.enabled_sources/source_settings (mcp_source_builder.rb:265-287) and never consults profile.tools_allowed, so configured MCP names reach the model beside a restrictive local profile. The CLI validates only that the runtime workspace root matches the CLI root (cli.rb:655-660). Recorded as a duplicate of CF05-SEC-01, NOT as a new F24 defect.

cli_authority.rb:168-180 pinned_authority replays the snapshot through Profile.from_authority and re-checks pinned.canonical_digest == stored_digest, so the CLI's own binding logic is sound. The recorded defect is in tamoz-agent-profile replay integrity, which is F21's seam.

The CLI resolves authority per invocation (cli_authority.rb:94-146) and the unattended path takes its toolbox from the resolved profile (worker_runtime.rb:1195-1209). The recorded defect is tamoz-agent WorkerRuntime#session_for profile binding on restart, which is F25's seam.

lens_evidence.correctness: All 28 SUBCOMMAND_HANDLERS entries (cli.rb:34-63) resolve to a cmd_* with a real effect; no accept-and-ignore option found (probe: --bogus on schedule/queue/comms list and observe metrics all return 64). Three proven defects: F24-ERR-01, F24-ERR-02, F24-ERR-03; plus the list positional drop at cli.rb:67/:151.
lens_evidence.security: CLI does NOT construct approval verdicts: cli.rb:510-526 only resolves through @approval_engine after decision_log.lookup confirms ownership. Profile authority is read, never computed (cli_authority.rb:94-146, :168-180). THREAD_ID_PATTERN (cli.rb:76) is anchored and applied before every path join; no path escape found. --root defaults to Dir.pwd (cli_argument_parser.rb:37) and is not workspace-influenceable. provision_private_session_dir! (cli.rb:608-615) refuses 0o077-accessible session dirs. CF05-SEC-01 reachable here (see duplicates).
lens_evidence.reliability: Signal handling installed but its result never converted to an exit code on the interactive path (cli.rb:688-694 nils @cancellation in ensure; only cancel_exit cli_session_commands.rb:234-239 consumes exit_for_cancellation) - recorded as an info-level contract/evidence gap, not a finding, because no deterministic in-process SIGINT probe was built. worker and comms serve both trap INT/TERM correctly (cli_worker_commands.rb:289-294, cli_comms_commands.rb:135-136). observe tail --follow installs no trap (F24-REL-01).
lens_evidence.observability: Envelope schema 1 with identity only on stream-backed parts (cli.rb:901-916); error taxonomy preserved (cli.rb:107-125 catches ToolError/ProtocolError/CheckpointConflictError explicitly rather than widening to Tamoz::Error); broken journal reports 'unavailable' not zeros (cli_worker_commands.rb:723-729); uncomputable view becomes approval_state 'unavailable' (cli_worker_commands.rb:508-543). Secret-redaction test passes. F24-INFO-02 notes one non-evidence-derived counter.
lens_evidence.scalability: Every list command is bounded: queue list 200 (cli_worker_commands.rb:251), status pending/occurrences/paused 500 (:477, :509, :546), comms delivery resolve 500 per surface (cli_comms_ops.rb:210), schedule occurrences default 100 (cli_schedule_commands.rb:246). --concurrency 0/-3 are not validated at the CLI but Worker#initialize clamps (1,32) at worker.rb:65, so the bound exists at the owning seam - not a CLI defect. observe tail --follow is the single unbounded surface (F24-REL-01). run_with_stream joins each thread before the next (cli.rb:409-424), so threads do not accumulate.
lens_evidence.maintenance: Dependency direction honest: gemspec:13-20 depends on tamoz-agent; tamoz/sqlite deferred to call time (cli.rb:580-582). Every extracted module's methods were private on CLI before extraction and stay private (cli_authority.rb:22-23, cli_rendering.rb:27-28, cli_profile_commands.rb:45-48). one_shot_routing/durable_routing divergence is deliberate and commented at both sites (cli.rb:199-207, :640-648). Root maintenance defect: NEEDS_HELP_CATCH (cli.rb:72-74) is a second hand-maintained list that must stay in sync with SUBCOMMAND_HANDLERS, and it has already drifted (F24-ERR-02, F24-ERR-03).

blind_spots: No deterministic end-to-end SIGINT/SIGTERM through CLI.run; the interactive family appears unable to return 130/143 despite cli.md:166, but this stays an info-level evidence gap. Highest-value follow-up for this row: instrument cli.rb:688-694 and cli_rendering.rb:124-138.
F24-SEC-01 terminal-injection reachability not reproduced through a real tty (hence medium confidence).
comms serve gateway supervision, the scheduler group and the profile group were read end to end but not exercised against real transports.
tamoz-telegram not read; build_transport loads it lazily (cli_comms_shared.rb:120-129) and its wire behaviour is outside F24.
